Plate Rater · best designs

You'll see FRC plates with lightening pockets, one at a time. Some were designed by teams and vendors, some by a pocketing tool we're training. These are the best designs so far, so most will look decent. Please use the whole 1–9 range anyway: the point is to separate the great ones from the merely good. Rate each the way you would in a design review.

  • 1 means you'd send it back. 9 means you'd cut it as is.
  • Judge the pocketing, not the plate outline or the hole layout. Those are fixed.
  • Go with your gut. A couple of seconds per plate is plenty.
  • Keys: 1–9 to rate, S to skip, Backspace to undo.
  • Your progress is saved in this browser. You can stop and export at any point, even after 50.
